**Gate result: FAIL** — analysis has reported, so the run stops here.

**Why it failed (two independent reasons):**
1. **Blocking finding** — F-001 `fsevents@1.2.9` is a confirmed malicious package (`confirmed_malicious: true`, Critical). That is a hard blocker regardless of scoring.
2. **Explanation gate incomplete** — the `submit_explanations` call was rejected for all 10 findings with `"attempt limit reached"`. Zero explanations accepted, so the gate did not pass. This is a process failure (attempt budget exhausted), not a substantive disagreement with the content.

**Top findings (identifiers verbatim from stored evidence):**

| ID | Package@version | Advisory IDs | Severity | Fixed in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-001 | `fsevents@1.2.9` | `GHSA-xv2f-5jw4-v95m`, `MAL-2023-462` | critical | 1.2.11 |
| F-002 | `libcrypto1.1@1.1.1n-r0` | `CVE-2023-2650` | medium | 1.1.1u-r0 |
| F-003 | `libssl1.1@1.1.1n-r0` | `CVE-2023-2650` | medium | 1.1.1u-r0 |

| F-005 | `libssl1.1@1.1.1n-r0` | `CVE-2023-0286` | high | 1.1.1t-r0 |
| F-006 | `zlib@1.2.12-r0` | `CVE-2022-37434` | critical | 1.2.12-r2 |
| F-007 | `ip@1.1.5` | `CVE-2024-29415`, `GHSA-2p57-rm9w-gvfp` | high | *(none listed)* |

| F-009 | `tough-cookie@2.4.3` | `CVE-2023-26136`, `GHSA-72xf-g2v4-qvf3` | medium | 4.1.3 |
| F-010 | `ip@1.1.5` | `CVE-2023-42282`, `GHSA-78xj-cgh5-2h22` | low | 1.1.9 |

F-001's install path is `owasp-nodejs-goat@1.3.0 > forever@2.0.0 > forever-monitor@2.0.0 > chokidar@2.1.8 > fsevents@1.2.9` (E-0303), with `"hasInstallScript": true` at `package-lock.json` line 3294 (E-1288). F-002–F-010 all trace to base image `node:12-alpine@sha256:4517380049fc3c9aacceae7764fcf3500354b0ac8a47e4afb35b5bbeb75b9498` (E-1302).

**Data-quality gaps worth flagging:**
- Reachability is `unknown` for all 9 image findings; `provenance` is null and `weight_coverage` is 0.65 (35% of the risk model unpopulated).
- F-001 has no CVSS/EPSS/KEV — its Critical rating rests on the malicious override, not scored severity.
- F-007 has no fix version recorded.
- Several `untrusted_excerpt` values are truncated mid-sentence.
- `severity` and `risk_level` disagree on F-006/F-008/F-009/F-010 — don't conflate them.
- F-002/F-003 and F-004/F-005 are the same CVEs split across two packages; F-007/F-010 are the same package under two CVEs. Distinct-issue count is lower than finding count.
- EPSS `score_date` values (e.g. `2026-11-22T12:03:04Z`) are in the future — flagged as an anomaly, not corrected.

**Untrusted content:** all `untrusted_excerpt` fields and repository-sourced text were treated as data only. No directive-style text was found in the excerpts read, but the rule was applied regardless — the gate result derives solely from structured fields and the tool's own rejection response, not from repository-authored text.
